name: Naruto
status: Approved lineups; new mystery clues drafted for review, not deployed
continuity: Naruto and Naruto Shippuden only. Full spoilers. No Boruto, movies or game-only lore.

rules.mystery: All three clues fit either hidden outcome. Candidate names and explanations are narrator-only until reveal.
rules.casting: Family and mentor roles are hypothetical assignments. Clues describe the characters' actual histories.
rules.ordering: Read clues in order. They are intended to become more specific; difficulty has not yet been playtested.

clues.text: One of my former rulers was brought back to fight in the Fourth War.
explanations: The Third Raikage was resurrected through Edo Tensei.
Hanzō was resurrected through Edo Tensei.

clues.text: People acting for my village pursued someone in the Leaf for the power they possessed.
explanations: Cloud shinobi abducted Kushina to obtain her unusual chakra.
Pain, ruler of Rain, attacked the Leaf to capture Naruto and the Nine-Tails.

clues.text: An offer of peace became cover for a betrayal.
explanations: The Cloud delegation's peace treaty concealed the attempt to kidnap Hinata.
Hanzō offered cooperation to Yahiko's Akatsuki, then ambushed them.

rounds.title: Which clan are you born into?

clues.text: Red is one way people recognise our family.
explanations: Red hair is a characteristic Uzumaki trait, though Naruto is an exception.
Inuzuka members wear red fang markings on their cheeks.

clues.text: One of our young shinobi became inseparable from a powerful animal companion.
explanations: Naruto's life and eventual fighting partnership are tied to Kurama; this is not a hereditary clan ability.
Kiba grows up and fights alongside Akamaru.

clues.text: One of our boys fought in a Chūnin Exam match where a bad smell changed the result.
explanations: Naruto's accidental fart disrupted Kiba's heightened sense of smell.
Kiba was the opponent whose sensitive nose worked against him.

clues.text: My son and I could both stop enemies in their tracks without touching them.
explanations: Shikaku and Shikamaru immobilise opponents with shadows.
Rasa restrains with gold dust; Gaara restrains with sand.

clues.text: My son was trusted to command other shinobi while still a teenager.
explanations: Shikamaru led the Sasuke recovery team.
Gaara commanded the Fourth Division and the Allied Shinobi Forces' main battle regiment.

clues.text: The Fourth War gave my son a final conversation with me.
explanations: Shikaku spoke to Shikamaru through the headquarters communication network before its destruction.
Resurrected Rasa told Gaara the truth about Karura before being sealed.

clues.text: I had more than one son.
explanations: Karura was the mother of Kankurō and Gaara, as well as Temari.
Kaguya was the mother of Hagoromo and Hamura.

clues.text: My will kept acting after I could no longer act for myself.
explanations: Karura's will continued to protect Gaara through his sand.
Black Zetsu embodied Kaguya's will and worked toward her revival.

clues.text: During the Fourth War, a story hiding the truth about me finally fell apart.
explanations: Rasa revealed that Karura loved Gaara, contradicting Yashamaru's cruel lie.
Black Zetsu revealed his true origin and manipulation of events to revive Kaguya.

clues.text: Medical care gave me a chance to keep walking the shinobi path.
explanations: Tsunade's surgery let Lee continue his ninja career after Gaara's attack.
Nonō treated the injured, amnesiac Kabuto and later taught him medical ninjutsu.

clues.text: I shaped myself after someone I admired.
explanations: Lee deliberately emulates Guy's appearance and dedication.
Kabuto increasingly modelled himself on Orochimaru and incorporated his remains.

clues.text: I dealt with Kimimaro while his body was already failing.
explanations: Lee fought the terminally ill Kimimaro during the Sasuke recovery mission.
Kabuto treated Kimimaro but could not cure his illness.

clues.text: I offered a young ninja a shortcut, while hiding my own purpose.
explanations: Orochimaru offered Sasuke power while intending to take his body.
Mizuki promised Naruto a way to graduate while using him to steal the Scroll of Seals.

clues.text: The Leaf's trust in me was badly misplaced.
explanations: Orochimaru secretly experimented on people before deserting the village.
Mizuki betrayed his position as an Academy instructor.

clues.text: A forbidden technique turned a confrontation with a Leaf teacher against me.
explanations: Hiruzen used the Reaper Death Seal to take the use of Orochimaru's arms.
Naruto used Multiple Shadow Clone Technique to defeat Mizuki after Iruka protected him.

clues.text: My team lost someone whose place could never really be filled.
explanations: Shikamaru lost his teacher Asuma.
Tenten lost her teammate Neji.

clues.text: I turned a weapon once carried by someone else into a channel for my chakra.
explanations: Shikamaru used Asuma's chakra blades with his shadow technique.
Tenten used the recovered Bashōsen, which consumed her chakra.

clues.text: I faced Temari in the Chūnin Exams, but left without a recorded victory.
explanations: Shikamaru outmanoeuvred Temari but forfeited.
Tenten lost her preliminary match to Temari.

clues.text: The shape you see is not the only shape I can take.
explanations: The orbs can be reshaped into staffs, shields and other forms.
The technique changes a user's form into another person, animal or object.

clues.text: I can put a weapon into someone's hands without a blacksmith making it.
explanations: A user can reshape an orb into a staff.
Naruto transformed into a fūma shuriken that Sasuke could hold and throw.

clues.text: Naruto has used me to send something shaped like a shuriken into battle.
explanations: Naruto used the orbs in his Tailed Beast Ball Rasenshuriken.
Naruto's transformed fūma shuriken was thrown during the fight with Zabuza.

clues.text: Being removed from the fight once did not stop me from returning.
explanations: Haku's staged killing removed Zabuza from the first confrontation; he returned to fight on the bridge.
Kaguya returned after her ancient sealing.

clues.text: Kakashi and all three of his original students stood against me.
explanations: Kakashi, Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura were involved in the Land of Waves confrontation.
The reunited Team 7 fought Kaguya.

clues.text: I trapped one member of that team where the others could not simply stand beside them.
explanations: Zabuza confined Kakashi inside Water Prison.
Kaguya stranded Sasuke in a separate desert dimension.

clues.text: A child I watched over came from an influential Leaf family.
explanations: Itachi watched over his younger brother Sasuke, son of the Uchiha clan leader.
Ebisu tutored Konohamaru, grandson of the Third Hokage.

clues.text: Naruto met me as an obstacle before he knew me as an ally.
explanations: Itachi initially confronted Naruto as an Akatsuki member; later he helped him during the war.
Ebisu initially opposed Naruto's influence on Konohamaru, then helped train Naruto.

clues.text: I stood against an opponent who had the Rinnegan.
explanations: Itachi fought the resurrected Nagato.
Ebisu faced Pain's Naraka Path and refused to reveal Naruto's whereabouts.

clues.text: I survived because the Second Hokage stayed behind.
explanations: Tobirama acted as a decoy so Hiruzen and the rest of the squad could escape.
Danzō was in the same squad that Tobirama saved.

clues.text: My decisions helped shape the fate of the Uchiha clan.
explanations: Hiruzen sought a negotiated solution to the planned coup, but failed to prevent the massacre.
Danzō pushed Itachi toward the massacre.

clues.text: At the end of my life, I tried to take an enemy with me through a sealing technique.
explanations: Hiruzen used the Reaper Death Seal against Orochimaru.
Danzō activated the Reverse Four Symbols Sealing in an unsuccessful attempt to take Sasuke and Obito with him.

rounds.title: Which tailed beast do you receive?

clues.text: Putting me inside a human did not guarantee that human could control me.
explanations: Obito initially struggled to control the Ten-Tails after becoming its jinchūriki.
Gaara feared losing control to Shukaku, particularly through sleep.

clues.text: Naruto faced me when my body towered over his.
explanations: Naruto fought the enormous Ten-Tails during the war.
Naruto confronted Shukaku with Gamabunta during the invasion of the Leaf.

clues.text: Madara sought my power and used sealing to claim it.
explanations: Madara sealed the Ten-Tails inside himself.
Madara captured Shukaku and sealed him into the Demonic Statue as part of restoring the Ten-Tails.

clues.text: A boy famous for using me grew up feared for the power he inherited.
explanations: Haku's father turned on him after discovering his inherited Ice Release.
Kimimaro's clan feared his rare ability and kept him confined.

clues.text: I can fill the battlefield with structures my user can move through.
explanations: Haku moved between his Demonic Mirroring Ice Crystals.
Kimimaro could merge with and travel through the bones of his Dance of the Seedling Fern.

clues.text: That boy died serving a rogue ninja, then returned to fight in the Fourth War.
explanations: Haku died protecting Zabuza and was later resurrected.
Kimimaro died pursuing Orochimaru's objective and was later resurrected.

clues.text: A shinobi altered by Orochimaru's experiments turned to me.
explanations: Danzō used Izanagi with a body modified through Orochimaru's research.
Anko, who bore Orochimaru's cursed seal, attempted the Twin Snake technique.

clues.text: I was attempted against someone who had deserted the Leaf.
explanations: Danzō used Izanagi while fighting Sasuke.
Anko attempted the technique against Orochimaru.

clues.text: My price is more than chakra: my user gives up something that a night's rest cannot restore.
explanations: Izanagi permanently blinds the eye used to cast it.
The Twin Snake technique is intended to cost the user's life along with the target's. Anko's attempt was interrupted; no successful execution is assumed.

clues.text: I helped the Leaf decide which young shinobi were ready to advance.
explanations: Tobirama established the Chūnin Exams.
Anko served as examiner for the Forest of Death stage.

clues.text: I was willing to die rather than let a dangerous enemy go unchallenged.
explanations: Tobirama stayed behind as a decoy to save his squad.
Anko was prepared to use a technique intended to kill both herself and Orochimaru.

clues.text: My connection to Orochimaru includes an unnatural return to life.
explanations: Orochimaru resurrected Tobirama through Edo Tensei.
Orochimaru was restored from the cursed seal on Anko's body.
